response.raw_text: {"overall_diagnosis":"The failure is a consistent SVG interactivity issue in the D3 visualization workflow: ticker <text> labels layered over bubble circles intercept pointer events, preventing Playwright from clicking the intended marks and triggering linked highlighting behavior. The d3-visualization skill currently emphasizes deterministic rendering but lacks explicit guidance for robust, automation-friendly SVG interaction patterns and event targeting.","diagnosed_skills":[{"path":"d3-visualization/SKILL.md","confidence":"0.87","diagnosis":"The skill does not explicitly address a common D3/SVG interaction pitfall where overlay text labels intercept pointer events and block clicks on underlying shapes. As a result, interactive linked-view behaviors can fail under browser automation even when the visualization logic is otherwise correct. The guidance also lacks recommendations for structuring interactive SVG nodes, stable selectors, and Playwright-compatible click targets.","repair_instruction":"Add a dedicated section on SVG interaction robustness and automated-test compatibility. Instruct users to: (1) set `pointer-events: none` on non-interactive overlay labels such as `<text>` elements; (2) prefer wrapping related marks in a `<g class=\"node\">` and attaching click/hover handlers to the group or topmost interactive element; (3) ensure clickable marks are not visually or interactively obscured; (4) use deterministic class names/data attributes for automated selectors; (5) include examples for bubble charts with labels showing `text.style('pointer-events','none')` or equivalent CSS; and (6) provide a checklist for Playwright-style interaction requirements such as visible, stable, enabled, unobstructed click targets and CSS-class-based highlight toggling."}],"unselected_skills":[]}
